facts.text: Belhaven awards traditional on-campus undergraduate students full-tuition scholarships for an online master's degree valued at up to $25,000.

sources.title: Free Master's Degree Offer: Belhaven University | Jackson, MS
sources.quote: Belhaven is the only university in the country to give​​ traditional-campus students full-tuition scholarships for an online master's degree … a value of up to $25,000!
